note: All harmful and shootable room objects. kind: enemy (harmful + shootable), hazard (harmful, bullet-proof), destructible (harmless but shootable). Contact with anything harmful drains 0x6000 energy every 4 ticks (~10 s from full). hits_to_kill uses each weapon's damage; ticks_to_kill_auto = (hits-1) * (cooldown+1) for auto-fire weapons held down. HP is restored when the object's path restarts. path: one pass through the object's steps.
